name: Intarsia Relief
description: Carving style that mimics the look of traditional intarsia woodworking — multiple flowing pieces with sharp internal edges, usually representing animals, landscapes, or figures in a puzzle-like composition. Color is implied via height variation and contour shape.
carving_traits: Sharp edge delineation between regions (like puzzle cuts)
Distinct Z-depth bands to simulate piece layering
Soft internal contours within each piece, with hard outer edges
Works best with stylized subjects: birds, mountains, animals, portraits
machinability_prompt: Generate a grayscale heightmap mimicking layered wood intarsia. Regions must have strong Z-band contrast and sharp outer edges. Background is flat black. No lighting, color, or texture.
